title: Quick Ache Component Property Evidence

actions.label: Commit Team A and Team B hypotheses

parameters.note: Team A and Team B hypotheses recorded before any property test, so neither can be edited to fit the result.

nodes.title: Consumer hypotheses
nodes.description: Commit the competing label-accuracy hypotheses before seeing the unknown composition.

feedback.retry: Complete consumer hypotheses with the required evidence.

nodes.title: Select property tests
nodes.description: Choose safe tests that can distinguish the three pure components without prescribing a fixed recipe.

config.requiredConfiguration: pure-component amounts and accepted property evidence

feedback.retry: Complete select property tests with the required evidence.

nodes.title: Test sucrose
nodes.description: Apply the approved test and record sucrose solubility or reactivity evidence.

feedback.retry: Complete test sucrose with the required evidence.

feedback.retry: Complete test acetaminophen with the required evidence.

feedback.retry: Complete test aspirin with the required evidence.

nodes.title: Compare property evidence
nodes.description: Build a three-component evidence matrix to support—not replace—the separation design.
